lots.title: Stockport Town Centre School – Multi-Disciplinary Design Team Appointment
lots.description: Appointment of an architecturally led multi-disciplinary design and advisory team to support the delivery of a new all-through school within Stockport town centre. Initial disciplines comprise Architect, MEP, Structural & Civil Engineer, Building Regulations Principal Designer and CDM Principal Designer, with additional disciplines to be reviewed/added at each RIBA stage. Competitive Flexible Procedure: Stage 1 is an open Expression of Interest evaluated against competency questions; up to three shortlisted suppliers proceed to Stage 2 (qualitative questions, pricing schedule and social value commitments) subject to a confidentiality/NDA. Primary focus for RIBA Stage 2 is to include MEP and Structural Engineers.
requirements: Deliver multi-disciplinary design services for a new all-through (primary and secondary phase) town centre school on a brownfield site in Stockport.

Architecturally led team comprising Architect, MEP, Structural & Civil Engineer, BR Principal Designer and CDM Principal Designer as the initial appointment, with additional disciplines added/reviewed at each RIBA stage.
Additional disciplines must be appointed by the Architect, either in-house or externally procured, to form the design team.
Compliance with RIBA Plan of Work and current Building Regulations (England and Wales).
Compliance with CDM 2015 Regulations and other statutory planning and heritage requirements.
Compliance with Building Safety Act 2022.
Compliance with the Council's Climate Action Now and Social Value commitments.
Compliance with Building Regulations Approved Document B (Fire Safety).
Compliance with BS 9999 – Code of Practice for Fire Safety in the Design, Management and Use of Buildings.
Compliance with the Environment Act 2021 and the Air Quality Standards Regulations 2010.
Compliance with inclusive design principles and BS 8300 (accessibility) and Equality Act 2010.
Compliance with British Standards (e.g. BS EN ISO 9001 for quality management, where applicable) and the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.
Design information to be shared via SMBC SharePoint platform.
BIM Level 2 with COBie data is a requirement.
Demonstrate sustainable design outcomes including environmental performance, energy efficiency, materials selection, and long-term operational impact.
All personnel must hold the requisite qualifications, skillsets and experience, including professional registration, accreditation and licensing per UK statutory and industry standards.
Suppliers may propose alternative standards/approaches provided technical equivalence or superior outcomes are demonstrated; burden of proof lies with the Supplier.
Consultant performance monitored by the Authorised Officer against an agreed Performance Framework, Outcomes and KPIs, with social/environmental monitoring as appropriate.
Progression to Stage 2 is subject to a confidentiality / non-disclosure agreement due to the sensitivity of the project.
Preliminary market engagement conducted over 30 business days with written responses to competency questions.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Stage 1 responses scored on a 0–6 scale: Unacceptable (0), Poor (1), Deficient (2), Satisfactory (3), Good (4), Excellent (5), Outstanding (6). A score of 0, 1 or 2 on any quality question results in full exclusion of the submission. Submissions are scored independently using this matrix.
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: Scores of 0, 1 or 2 trigger full exclusion; maximum score per question is 6 (Outstanding).

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Performance Framework KPIs (contract performance, not award)
evaluation_criteria.summary: Seven Pass/Fail KPIs form Stage 2 performance monitoring: (1a) minimal design queries/changes during tender period, (2) design meets client requirements, (3) design meets budget, (4) meeting attendance, (5) site attendance, (6) proactive duties (3 working day email response, early warnings, liaison, snag logging), (7) Social Value commitment delivery. All measured via feedback at Design Team Meetings.
